sloka: हितं नैष ममैतद्धि ब्रवीति धनरक्षकः ।महेश्वरसखित्वं तु मूढ श्रावयते किल ।। ७.१३.३६ ॥
transliteration: hitaṁ naiṣa mamaitaddhi bravīti dhanarakṣakaḥ ।maheśvarasakhitvaṁ tu mūḍha śrāvayate kila ।। 7.13.36 ॥

translations.english: This protector of wealth (Kubera) is not speaking what is beneficial for me; rather, this fool is indeed making me hear about his friendship with Maheśvara.
